Russia.relationship: Time-tested strategic partner; major defense and energy supplier.
Russia.defense_dependence: High — large legacy fleet of Russian-origin arms (S-400, Su-30, tanks, spares).
Russia.energy: Became India's largest crude supplier post-2022 via steep discounts.
Russia.stance: India maintains strategic neutrality; keeps buying discounted crude despite Western pressure.

Ukraine.relationship: Friendly but limited; historically a source of some defense components and sunflower oil.
Ukraine.energy: Not a direct energy supplier to India.
Ukraine.stance: India calls for dialogue; provides humanitarian aid.

Israel.defense_dependence: Moderate–high for advanced systems (drones, missiles, radar).
Israel.energy: Not a direct supplier; relevant via regional oil-price risk.
Israel.stance: Warm bilateral ties; India balances with Gulf/Iran energy interests.

Iran.relationship: Historic energy and connectivity partner (Chabahar port); constrained by sanctions.
Iran.energy: Former major crude supplier; now limited by sanctions but key to Hormuz shipping route.
Iran.stance: India balances Iran ties with Israel/Gulf relations.

China.relationship: Strategic rival and largest source of imports; frozen border standoff.
China.energy: Not an energy supplier; competitor for global commodities.

United States.relationship: Strategic partner; largest export market and a key defense-tech and energy supplier.
United States.energy: Rising LNG and crude supplier to India.
United States.stance: Deepening ties; India benefits from 'China+1' and services/IT exports.

Saudi Arabia.relationship: Top crude supplier and major Gulf partner; large Indian diaspora.
Saudi Arabia.energy: Among India's largest crude and LPG suppliers.

UAE.relationship: Major trade hub, crude/LPG supplier, and CEPA free-trade partner.
UAE.energy: Key crude and LPG supplier; re-export hub.
UAE.stance: Close economic ties; large Indian workforce and remittances.

Indonesia.relationship: Key supplier of thermal coal and palm oil.

Venezuela.relationship: Historic heavy-crude supplier constrained by sanctions.
Venezuela.stance: Opportunistic crude buyer when sanctions ease.

North Korea.stance: Negligible trade; relevance is global risk sentiment.

South Korea.relationship: Electronics, auto and steel trade partner (CEPA).

Bangladesh.relationship: Key neighbour and trade partner; rival apparel-export hub.
Bangladesh.stance: Close but sensitive; instability raises border and migration concerns and shifts garment orders to India.

Myanmar.relationship: North-eastern neighbour; connectivity (Kaladan) and security focus.
Myanmar.stance: Engages the junta pragmatically while managing border security and refugee flows.
